name.ja: メアリ・ウルストンクラフト

overview.en: Mary Wollstonecraft was a British writer and philosopher who is considered the founder of feminist philosophy. Her Vindication of the Rights of Woman argued for women's equality.

early_life.en: Wollstonecraft was born in London to a family of declining means. Largely self-educated, she worked as a governess and teacher before becoming a writer and political commentator.

impact.en: Wollstonecraft's Vindication of the Rights of Woman is a foundational text of feminism. Her arguments for women's education and equality influenced the suffragist movements and modern gender equality.

text.en: I do not wish women to have power over men, but over themselves.
